 Powerica Ltd has received an income-tax refund of ₹15.98 crore for assessment year 2025-26 after the Income Tax Department accepted the company's contentions in a rectification proceeding relating to an earlier tax demand. In a disclosure to the stock exchanges on November 13, the company said it received an order dated July 2, 2026, passed under Section 154 of the Income-tax Act, 1961, on November 2, 2026. The rectification followed verification of the intimation issued under Section 143(1), the rectification order, the company's rectification application and supporting documents and records available with the Income Tax Department. " The contentions raised by the Company have been found to be correct," Powerica said, adding that the necessary rectification had been carried out, resulting in the determination of a total income-tax refund of ₹15,98,56,158 payable to the company. The development follows an earlier disclosure dated June 29, 2026, concerning an income-tax demand raised against the company for assessment year 2025-26. In its regulatory filing, Powerica identified the Office of the Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax , Circle 3(4), as the authority from which it received the communication. The company clarified that the order would have no material impact on its financials, operations or other activities during the current financial year. It also stated that no penalty, restriction or sanction had been imposed pursuant to the communication. Powerica apologised for the delay in disclosing the development, stating that it had inadvertently missed the November 2 email communication from the tax authorities owing to the high-priority workload of finalising its financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
